This appendix will explain the implemented SBayesRC-style
annotation-dependent BayesR prior, generalized probit stick-breaking
construction, and diagnostic helpers in full mathematical detail. The core
prior family is closely aligned with the published SBayesRC prior structure,
but the exposed default gamma grid and CSR sparse-LD likelihood differ from
the published GCTB implementation.
